mprRoomFinishing.t67: The value of the source-parameter is collected from rooms linked to finishing elements grouped by type sorted and written comma-separated to the target parameter of each room finishing element. For example if finishing elements of the same type belong to rooms with source-parameter values "3" "1" and "5" then "1, 3, 5" will be written to the specified target parameter of these elements. The "Create ranges" option merges sequences of numbers with a hyphen for example "3-5"
